query: We are in the enterprise tenancy and need an App Catalog on our test and prod sites.
expected_behavior: Identifies Path A: developers lack Tenant Admin rights, so a ticket to the organization's SharePoint administration team is needed
Fills in the ticket template with the two target site URLs and cites the prior approved reference tickets

query: I own a trial tenant and have Global Admin. Create the catalog on https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Dev.
expected_behavior: Identifies Path B and connects to the tenant admin site (-admin.sharepoint.com), not the target site
Gives Connect-PnPOnline to the admin URL followed by Add-PnPSiteCollectionAppCatalog -Site <url>
Leaves the tenant write to the user

query: I connected to the site URL and Add-PnPSiteCollectionAppCatalog failed.
expected_behavior: Explains the connection must be to the tenant admin site URL, not the target site collection
Asks the user to reconnect to the -admin.sharepoint.com URL
Offers the Admin Center walkthrough as an alternative
